newsitem.title: UK: UK airfreight players urge simplified EU Customs.
newsitem.headline: UK airfreight players urge simplified EU Customs.

text.p: The UK Air Freight Forum (AFF) said it has endorsed a Freight Transport Association (FTA) proposal aimed at simplifying EU Customs and VAT procedures for its members.

In a statement issued after its latest meeting held in London, the forum -- made up of 20 major shippers (exporters and importers), airlines and airfreight forwarders -- said it saw an FTA 'one-stop shop' proposal as an important objective.
It said the proposal, if adopted, would "revolutionise" the traditional ways in which business and Customs authorities worked together.
The statement said it would enable any company based within the European Union to choose which state Customs and Excise authority it wished to use for all its Customs and VAT affairs.

"We will be seeking UK Customs response to the proposal at our next meeting in London on July 1," said Andrew Traill, shipping and air manager of shippers' body the Freight Transport Association (FTA).
